dct_description_sm:
​The building outlines is a 2D data set defined by the generalized outermost exterior outline of main building components generated from the City of Vancouver’s 2015 orthophotos. Contiguous building outlines are split at parcel lines, where required, to reflect ownership. Also included are larger accessory buildings such as garages.

Note

​Data are approximate. Care must be taken in using them because of the significant number of changes since collected year. They are best used for comparison purposes only.

Data currency

​This dataset reflects conditions in 2015 and is not being updated.

Data accuracy

​The dataset reflects the approximate building footprints in 2015 and are best used for comparison purposes only.
